segment.source: Look at you, pretty $(#boy/girl), walkin' around like you're the boss of the place. ::Coughs.::<end>
segment.target: Look at you, pretty $(#boy/girl), walkin' around like you're the boss of the place. ::Coughs.::<end>

segment.source: You... you look so tender and... *so* delicious.<end>
segment.target: You... you look so tender and... *so* delicious.<end>

segment.source: Nice face you got there. It would be a shame if someone was to eat it. ::Coughs.::<end>
segment.target: Nice face you got there. It would be a shame if someone was to eat it. ::Coughs.::<end>

segment.source: Old Mike got his right arm and leg bitten off the other day and died from bleedin'. Poor man.<end>
segment.target: Old Mike got his right arm and leg bitten off the other day and died from bleedin'. Poor man.<end>

segment.source: ::The bum gives you a voracious stare.::<end>
segment.target: ::The bum gives you a voracious stare.::<end>

segment.source: I'm so hungry I could kill a man and eat him whole. $(#/Or a woman...)<end>
segment.target: I'm so hungry I could kill a man and eat him whole. $(#/Or a woman...)<end>

segment.source: My mother always told me not to play with my food. I'd take 'er advice if I had any.<end>
segment.target: My mother always told me not to play with my food. I'd take 'er advice if I had any.<end>
